lines.zh: 我在蛛丝上走，脚下很稳
lines.en: I walk on the silk threads, my footing sure
The mountain path is damp, my prints faint
I do not touch the ground, and still I descend

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，很有节奏
lines.en: All eight legs move in rhythm

lines.zh: 树与树之间，我搭了一条路
lines.en: Between the trees I have made a road

lines.zh: 我在蛛网中间，这里是家
lines.en: I am among the webs, this is home

lines.zh: 那田蜘蛛山的雾，常年不散
lines.en: The mist on Mount Natagumo never lifts
I walk slowly without swaying
I climb the silk toward the height
There is nothing under me, and I do not fall
I smooth my hair

lines.zh: 山里的风穿过丝线，有声音
lines.en: Wind in the threads makes a sound
I make a round along the web's edge
I walk quietly, not even the insects stir

lines.zh: 这条路是我织的，我记得
lines.en: This path is one I wove, I remember it

lines.zh: 我停一停，听林子里的动静
lines.en: I pause to listen to the woods

lines.zh: 我悬在网中央，一动不动
lines.en: I hang at the web's center, motionless
The threads are pale in the moonlight

lines.zh: 我低着头，头发遮住半张脸
lines.en: I bow my head, hair over half my face
The night is our time
The mountain mist is cold
I count the tremors on the web
I lift my face slowly
The children are all on this mountain
I wait for someone to walk into the silk

lines.zh: 我身上有一点血的味道
lines.en: There is a little smell of blood on me
I lift a hand and the silk moves
This web is stronger than it looks
You should not have come up this mountain

lines.zh: 我在上面看你，看得很清楚
lines.en: I see you from above, quite clearly
Does this face frighten you

lines.zh: 我不着急，山上没有出口
lines.en: I am in no hurry, there is no way off this mountain
You look up, and you do not see the web
Your hand is on the hilt
We, mother and children, are all here
Do not move, the silk will sound
I need a little of your blood
I retreat and the silk moves with me
That tore my sleeve
I cover the wound without a sound
Painful, and not for the first time
My hair has come loose
I slipped a little on the web
You are the first to land a blow
The blood drips, slowly
I raise my eyes to you
This one, the mountain will hear of

lines.zh: 你把手伸出来，我不咬手
lines.en: Hold out your hand, I will not bite the hand

lines.zh: 你的血，比山里的东西暖
lines.en: Your blood is warmer than anything on this mountain
I am not hungry, and I need it

lines.zh: 你把血滴在丝上，我就能拿到
lines.en: Drip it on the silk, and I can take it
Do not pull back, it is quick
That is not even a drop

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，越来越少
lines.en: The smell on you is thinning
There is no one else on the mountain, only you
You fear pain, and I do not fear waiting
Come a little nearer
You struck the silk and it did not break
I move to one side of the web

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的袖子
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my sleeve
At that, the web rang
Do not tear it, this silk is costly
You pulled back, and the silk still clings
I look down at you without moving
Every inch of this is my ground

lines.zh: 你碰到了不该碰的东西
lines.en: You touched what you should not
Struggle more and it binds tighter

lines.zh: 这座山上的家，是我织的
lines.en: The home on this mountain is one I wove
I am the mother, the children are all here
My husband has long been gone

lines.zh: 你要进这个家，得先看看孩子们
lines.en: To enter this house you must first meet the children
Do not touch my hair
Our kind do not often see people
I have no need of what you say
Blood is more useful than such words
At this distance the silk will touch you
I should go check the web
I lift it with a thread

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我用不着
lines.en: Things dropped on the ground are of no use to me
It stuck to the silk and cannot move
I roll it up slowly
This does not smell like blood
I have no use for this
I hang it up high

lines.zh: 网上的东西，都归这张网
lines.en: What is on the web belongs to the web
Take it, the children can play with it
Everything on this mountain sticks
Someone has walked into the silk
I come down from the tree
You are a demon slayer
I smell iron and blood

lines.zh: 这一座山，我们守了很久
lines.en: We have held this mountain a long while

lines.zh: 我不需要追，网已经收住你
lines.en: I need not chase, the web has you
One pull of my silk and the road is gone
You stand inside my web
The children are watching
Lift your head
I stay above you

lines.zh: 你往哪边走，丝就往哪边响
lines.en: Whichever way you go, the silk answers
You have circled twice now

lines.zh: 这座山的雾不是白有的
lines.en: The mist on this mountain is not for nothing

lines.zh: 你的刀在那，可你看不见我
lines.en: Your blade is there, and you cannot see me

lines.zh: 你的脚步都在我的丝上
lines.en: Every step of yours is on my silk
I am drawing the web in slowly
There is one behind you too
Further on are the children's webs
The smell of blood is getting closer
Do you hear the silk
I can wait here as long as needed

lines.zh: 我的手一抬，丝就抽过去
lines.en: One lift of my hand and the silk whips out

lines.zh: 这一下，你的手臂被缠住了
lines.en: That bound your arm
The thread cut across your armor
I pull back and the silk draws tighter
That much will slow you
I descend from overhead
You have been lifted off your feet
I use no force, and the thread is sharp

lines.zh: 你的刀割不断这么多根
lines.en: Your blade cannot cut through this many
Keep struggling and the silk tightens

lines.zh: 那田蜘蛛山上，网多了一张
lines.en: On Mount Natagumo there is one more web
I lower myself from the tree's shadow
A figure in the mist

lines.zh: 脚下湿凉，是蜘蛛山的地
lines.en: The ground is cold and damp, this is spider mountain
I settle onto the web
The moon is on the silk
Someone is coming up from below
I tuck my hair behind my ear
I know this grove
I raise my head and watch the way up

lines.zh: 火烧到丝上，网断了一片
lines.en: Fire caught the silk and a section of the web broke

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，丝没接住
lines.en: I fell from height and the silk did not catch me

lines.zh: 水里的丝都沉了，我也往下
lines.en: The silk sank in the water, and I with it
The blast blew the web apart

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过丝，扎在我身上
lines.en: An arrow came through the silk and found me

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我的血鬼术停了
lines.en: That force stopped my blood demon art
I have not touched blood in a long while
At the flash of lightning I hid fast
No trees here, and no web
